description: This file defines a dataset mapper class for the Detectron2 object detection framework, specifically tailored for the DETR model. It includes functions for building data augmentation transforms, reading and processing images, and preparing annotations for training or inference.

classes.name: DetrDatasetMapper
classes.description: A class that maps dataset dictionaries into a format suitable for the DETR model, including image transformations and annotation processing.

methods.name: build_transform_gen
methods.description: Creates a list of transformation generators based on configuration and training mode.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DetrDatasetMapper with configuration, setting up cropping, transformations, and image format.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Processes a dataset dictionary: reads image, applies transformations, processes annotations, and returns the modified dataset dictionary.
